after_view: Unmodified Sources/App/MarketplacePluginDetailView.swift at the original implementation commit 3b0cfdf0e865bccb3f0d9457e778c39492c1bf37
snapshot_scope: The PNGs, capture source archive, and recorded source/fixture hashes are frozen to the original capture revisions. Later operation-lifetime and startup-state fixes preserve the pictured normal progress and installed/loaded permission states but were not rerendered or verified by these images. The recorded hashes do not identify the later patched sources.
capture_method: Native macOS SwiftUI/AppKit rendering in isolated NSHostingView inside a temporary fixture NSWindow. Save bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay/cacheDisplay as PNG. No generative imaging, compositing, retouching, cropping, or resized deliverables.
localization: Both before and after use identical English Plugins.strings generated from the original implementation's localization catalog at 3b0cfdf0e865bccb3f0d9457e778c39492c1bf37. The before view does not consume the added operation/setup-status keys. PluginRuntimeLocalization.source.setPreference("en") changes only the process locale snapshot; no preferences are saved.

installing.interaction: Deliver NSEvent mouse down/up to fixture window Install button; require didStartInstall == true before saving. Original before view sets its own activeOperation @State. After view reads host operation snapshot. Fixture async operation suspends and never downloads a package.

setup-needed.interaction: Deterministic installed/loaded fixture, with both permissions marked ungranted. Permission cards use actual TrackpadGestures English requirement descriptions/footnotes and host icon/button conventions. No repair buttons invoked.

fixture_substitutes: PluginHost with deterministic management, operation, runtime, settings, and permission snapshots
Minimal PluginPackageManifest nested type substitutes required by PluginManagementItem; these fields are unused by rendering
permissionGuidanceSourceFrame inert substitute, unused because repair buttons are not pressed
suppressed_external_effects: No real plugin installation or download
No TCC permission checks or permission prompts
No real MacTools app launch or app preference writes
No global input events: installation clicks are delivered directly into the fixture window
limitations: These are genuine native renderings of the exact detail view with deterministic fixture data, not screenshots of a real completed catalog download or the whole Settings window.
After captures reflect the original implementation at 3b0cfdf0e865bccb3f0d9457e778c39492c1bf37. They do not establish the behavior of later operation-lifetime or startup-state fixes.
Fixture lifecycle/navigation/permission callbacks do not validate the actual host side effects.
Captures cover light appearance in English on macOS 27.2; keyboard navigation, VoiceOver, hardware permissions, macOS 14 appearance, and Search routing are not established by these PNGs.
generation_commands: For each phase: xcrun swiftc -swift-version 6 -module-cache-path /tmp/mactools-471-screenshots/harness/module-cache -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -F build/DerivedDataTests/Build/Products/Debug -framework MacToolsPluginKit -Xlinker -rpath -Xlinker <repo>/build/DerivedDataTests/Build/Products/Debug <harness>/{BeforeView|AfterView}.swift <harness>/{FixtureSupport,ManagementItem,ProductMetadata,AppL10n,Targets,PermissionRow,SetupPresentation,MarketplaceOperation,Category,DetailCopy,CaptureMain}.swift -o <harness>/{before|after}.app/Contents/MacOS/capture
